description: Moonlight silvers the pale ridges of the Corralejo dunes, the hollows sinking into soft shadow. To the left the dark cone of Montaña Roja stands against the stars, and to the right the silhouette of Isla de Lobos rests on the horizon over the sea. The model sky is essentially clear (1% cloud), and nothing here is lit but the moon — a quiet coastal desert at night.
